description: Clean, contemporary lines meet old-world strength in the Hudson Convertible Crib. Handcrafted from solid American hardwoods, this 4-in-1 design offers smooth transitions from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed while delivering the safety and stability every parent wants. Modern enough for today’s nurseries yet built to last a lifetime, it’s the smart, stylish choice that grows with your family.
